title: Create dynamic token budget calculator module chatbot/core/token_budget.py
description:
Implement a token budget calculator in chatbot/core/token_budget.py that dynamically allocates context window space across persona, memory, history, and scene based on the target model window size and content relevance.

Before editing, inspect:
- chatbot/config.py to see where model context limits and configurations are defined.
acceptance_criteria: The module exposes a calculator that computes budgets for persona, memory, history, and scene
